programme.title: The Children's Hour (1962)
programme.desc: In this provocatively daring film, an attention-seeking schoolgirl vengefully spreads rumors that her teachers (Audrey Hepburn and Shirley MacLaine) are lesbians.

programme.title: Guys and Dolls
programme.desc: In New York, a gambler is challenged to take a cold female missionary to Havana, but they fall for each other, and the bet has a hidden motive to finance a crap game.

programme.title: The Fugitive Kind
programme.desc: In this Tennessee Williams masterpiece, Marlon Brando is superb as a paradoxical drifter drawn into the desperate lives of two passionate women, Maureen Stapleton and Joanne Woodward, in a small Mississippi town.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor Admiral James Greer becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: "The Ruins" follows a group of friends who become entangled in a struggle for survival after visiting a remote archaeological dig in the Mexican jungle where they discover something deadly living among the ruins.

programme.title: Dark Tide
programme.desc:
Kate accepts a lucrative opportunity to lead a thrill-seeking millionaire businessman on a shark dive in the most dangerous waters, outside the cage.
PG-13

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair face an even bigger threat lurking below the surface.

programme.title: The Wood
programme.desc: Lots of guys have second thoughts about marriage. Three hours before his wedding, Roland is having third, fourth and fifth thoughts. Good thing he’s got buddies Slim and Mike around to help.

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
programme.desc: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.

programme.title: Attack the Block
programme.desc: ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick ass heroes.

programme.title: Eye For An Eye: The Blind Swordsman
programme.desc: After being caught in the middle of a power struggle that results in the assassination of an innocent woman, a highly trained and exceptionally deadly swordsman seeks justice—and revenge.

programme.title: Eye For An Eye 2: Blind Vengeance
programme.desc: Blind Cheng (Tse Miao) runs into young orphan Xiaoyu (Yang Enyou) while both are run from the authorities. He reluctantly agrees to shelter her, leading to a series of violent battles featuring some of China’s finest martial arts in years.

programme.title: Kill Zone
programme.desc: An inspector and his unit are after a crime boss and are willing to capture him at all costs. The crime boss enlists his top henchmen to end their dirty schemes.

programme.title: The 4:30 Movie
programme.desc: In Kevin Smith's most personal film to date, a teenage cinephile tries to woo the girl of his dreams while dealing with a hilarious mix of friends and enemies at his local cinema.

programme.title: The Overnight
programme.desc: Alex (Adam Scott), Emily (Taylor Schilling) and their son RJ are new to LA. A chance meeting, introduces them to the mysterious Kurt (Jason Schwartzman), Charlotte and Max. A family playdate becomes increasingly interesting as the night goes on.

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Meet all the notorious suspects and discover all their foul play things. You'll love their dastardly doings as the bodies and the laughs pile up before your eyes. Featuring all three surprise endings!!

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother/daughter con team. Max targets wealthy men and marries them. Page then seduces them while Max "catches" her wayward husbands in the act. Then on to the next mark, posing in a variety of guises to keep one step ahead of the law.

programme.title: America's Sweethearts
programme.desc: For Kiki (Julia Roberts), being the personal assistant to the beautiful megastar, Gwen (Catherine Zeta-Jones), isn't easy. In fact, it's nearly impossible since the man of her dreams is Eddie (John Cusack), Gwen's estranged husband.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: When his daughter brings home her new fiancé, her uptight father discovers she's neglected to tell him three things: He's broke. He's unemployed. And he's white.

programme.title: Most Beautiful Island
programme.desc: An undocumented woman struggling in NYC is offered an opportunity she can’t refuse, but soon discovers she’s involved in a dangerous game. Grand Jury Award Winner of SXSW 2017. Official Selection of BAMCinemaFest, Fantasia Fest, and Sidewalk.

programme.title: 100 Streets
programme.desc: 100 Streets is a powerful ensemble drama, follows three contrasting and interwoven stories as they play out in one square mile of modern day London starring Idris Elba and Gemma Arteton.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Matt Damon plays Rudy Baylor, a rookie lawyer in over his head on a high-profile case. Opposing him: an army of legal sharks. On Rudy’s side: Deck Shifflet, a feisty “paralawyer” who specializes in flunking the bar exam.

programme.title: The Whale
programme.desc: A reclusive English teacher (Brendan Fraser), living alone in the wake of a tragedy, attempts to reconnect with his teenage daughter for a chance at redemption in filmmaker Darren Aronofsky's emotional story of heartache, empathy, and grace.

programme.title: Minari
programme.desc: A tender and sweeping story about what roots us, Minari follows a Korean-American family that moves to an Arkansas farm in search of their own American Dream.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar Gilkyson (Robert Redford) lives on a Wyoming ranch with his only friend, Mitch (Morgan Freeman). Then, suddenly, the woman he blames for his son's death arrives at his door broke, desperate, and with a granddaughter he's never known.

programme.title: Brimstone

programme.title: Guys and Dolls
programme.desc: In New York, a gambler is challenged to take a cold female missionary to Havana, but they fall for each other, and the bet has a hidden motive to finance a crap game.

programme.title: The Fugitive Kind
programme.desc: In this Tennessee Williams masterpiece, Marlon Brando is superb as a paradoxical drifter drawn into the desperate lives of two passionate women, Maureen Stapleton and Joanne Woodward, in a small Mississippi town.

programme.title: Odd Man Out
programme.desc: A wounded Irish nationalist leader attempts to evade police following a failed robbery in Belfast.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor Admiral James Greer becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair face an even bigger threat lurking below the surface.

programme.title: Rogue
programme.desc: A rugged American adventure-travel journalist on assignment in the Australian outback encounters a man-eating crocodile.

programme.title: Feast
programme.desc: Customers locked inside a bar are forced to fight monsters.

programme.title: Attack the Block
programme.desc: ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick ass heroes.

programme.title: Bebe's Kids
programme.desc: When ladies' man Robin meets the beautiful Jamika at a funeral service, he feels he must have died and gone to heaven.

programme.title: The Wood
programme.desc: Lots of guys have second thoughts about marriage. Three hours before his wedding, Roland is having third, fourth and fifth thoughts. Good thing he’s got buddies Slim and Mike around to help.

programme.title: Kill Zone
programme.desc: An inspector and his unit are after a crime boss and are willing to capture him at all costs. The crime boss enlists his top henchmen to end their dirty schemes.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2
programme.desc: When his cover gets blown, a Hong Kong cop (Wu Jing) lands in a Thai prison where the warden works with a criminal mastermind (Louis Koo) to harvest organs.

programme.title: Preman: Silent Fury
programme.desc: After his son witnesses a brutal murder by a notorious crime boss, a deaf Indonesian gangster is thrust into the fight of his life when he takes on his dangerous former allies—including a sociopathic assassin—in order to protect his child.

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Meet all the notorious suspects and discover all their foul play things. You'll love their dastardly doings as the bodies and the laughs pile up before your eyes. Featuring all three surprise endings!!

programme.title: Hot Rod
programme.desc: A comedy about a stunt man who’s never successfully landed a jump without wiping out and his attempt to master the biggest stunt of his life.

programme.title: Encino Man
programme.desc: Two high school buddies dig up a frozen caveman in their backyard!

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: When his daughter brings home her new fiancé, her uptight father discovers she's neglected to tell him three things: He's broke. He's unemployed. And he's white.

programme.title: Bewitched (2005)
programme.desc: A has-been actor tries to convince the perfect woman to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series; a woman who, unbeknownst to him, really is a witch!

programme.title: Ella Enchanted
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Anne Hathaway stars in an unforgettable, modern fairy tale in which a girl's given the gift of obedience by her Fairy Godmother. An amazing, magical adventure bursting with colorful characters, music, wit, and whimsy.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Matt Damon plays Rudy Baylor, a rookie lawyer in over his head on a high-profile case. Opposing him: an army of legal sharks. On Rudy’s side: Deck Shifflet, a feisty “paralawyer” who specializes in flunking the bar exam.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: REVOLVER is populated with Guy Ritchie's (Snatch; Lock, Stock & Two Smoking Barrels) classic breed of fast-talking, sharp-suited gangsters but with a psychological twist that your mind may not be able to handle.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar Gilkyson (Robert Redford) lives on a Wyoming ranch with his only friend, Mitch (Morgan Freeman). Then, suddenly, the woman he blames for his son's death arrives at his door broke, desperate, and with a granddaughter he's never known.

programme.title: The Whale
programme.desc: A reclusive English teacher (Brendan Fraser), living alone in the wake of a tragedy, attempts to reconnect with his teenage daughter for a chance at redemption in filmmaker Darren Aronofsky's emotional story of heartache, empathy, and grace.

programme.title: Licorice Pizza
programme.desc: Licorice Pizza' is the story of Alana Kane and Gary Valentine growing up, running around and falling in love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973. Written and Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, the film tracks the treacherous navigation of first love.

programme.title: Damsel
programme.desc: A businessman travels West to join his fiancée in the mountains.

programme.title: The Conspirator
programme.desc: From director Robert Redford comes the riveting true story behind the assassination trial of Abraham Lincoln – including the lone woman who was accused of plotting his murder.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Exploring lost empires and finding priceless treasures... it's all in a day's work for Lara Croft. Though, a secret from her father's past is about to lead Lara to her greatest challenge.

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Lara Croft sets out on a quest to save Pandora's box from landing into the wrong hands. Join her as she races through furious hand-to-hand battles, blazing shoot-outs and breathtaking sky-diving escapes to try to save the ancient artifact.

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic. Still, things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people in this hilarious and action-packed adventure.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: Julie & Julia, tells the true stories of how Julia Child's life and cookbook inspired fledgling writer Julie Powell to whip up 524 recipes in 365 days and introduce a new generation to the magic of French cooking.

programme.title: The Fifth Element
programme.desc: Bruce Willis, Milla Jovovich, and Gary Oldman star in acclaimed director Luc Besson's outrageous sci-fi adventure, an extravagantly styled tale of good against evil set in an unbelievable twenty-third century world.

programme.title: We Own the Night
programme.desc: What if your own family stood in the way of everything you worked for? Bobby Green (Joaquin Phoenix) has forsaken his name to escape his family and their tradition in law enforcement to pursue his ambitions as a Brooklyn nightclub owner. Rated R

programme.title: Cutthroat Island
programme.desc: A female pirate and her companion race against their rivals to find a hidden island that contains a fabulous treasure.

programme.title: Popeye
programme.desc: The legendary, beloved anvil-armed sailor of the seven seas comes magically to life in this delightful musical, starring Robin Williams as Popeye, who meets all challenges with the unshakable philosophy, "I yam what I yam and that's all that I yam."

programme.title: The Pope of Greenwich Village
programme.desc: Daryl Hannah, Mickey Rourke and Eric Roberts star in this funny, high-voltage story of two small-time thieves after a big score in New York's Little Italy.

programme.title: Mom And Dad
programme.desc: A teenage girl and her little brother must survive a wild 24 hours during which a mass hysteria of unknown origins causes parents to turn violently on their own kids.

programme.title: Cooties
programme.desc: Teachers have the worst Monday ever when their students are turned into little killer savages in this horror comedy with unexpected laughs and unapologetic thrills.

programme.title: Come to Daddy
programme.desc: Elijah Wood is a man in his thirties who receives an invitation to a remote cabin for a visit with his father after a lifetime of estrangement. What he gets is much more than he ever expected!

programme.title: Young Guns II
programme.desc: The West has changed since The Regulators last rode through. Cornered by the ruthless cattle kings and double-crossed by corrupt government officials, Billy the Kid leads the Regulators down a treacherous trail towards Old Mexico… and destiny.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st airborne division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: Next of Kin
programme.desc: When policeman Truman Gates' younger brother is murdered by the mob, Gates is torn between his desire to uphold the law and his lust for revenge. But Gates' older brother will not be satisfied until every member of the Chicago mob is dead.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father Dusty (Wahlberg) shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Dinner for Schmucks
programme.desc: There’s only one thing keeping aspiring executive Tim from corporate success. He must find the perfect guest to bring to his boss’s monthly dinner party, where the winner of the evening is the one who arrives with the biggest buffoon.

programme.title: Pain & Gain
programme.desc: When an ambitious group of personal trainers go after the American Dream, they get caught up in a criminal enterprise that goes horribly wrong. Now, living large will take everything they've got in this unbelievable and outrageous true story.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Showdown at the Grand
programme.desc: A proud movie theater owner must defend his family business from corporate developers alongside a legendary action star as art imitates life in a showdown for the ages.

programme.title: Better Luck Tomorrow
programme.desc: To his classmates and teachers, high-schooler Ben Manibag appears to be the model student: a perfectionist and overachiever. But underneath this persona is a darker side. Ben and his bored high-school buddies lead double lives.

programme.title: Bound
programme.desc: Caesar’s a guy who launders money for the mob. What’s the last thing that would come between a sleazy wise guy like Caesar and that money? A couple of women with brains to die for and bodies to match.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A struggling screenwriter inadvertently becomes entangled in the Los Angeles criminal underworld after his oddball friends kidnap a gangster's beloved Shih Tzu.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D. and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earths closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: The Phantom
programme.desc: The story begins as an expedition lands on the island of Bengalla, seeking the Skulls of Touganda. Believed to harness an energy force of power, they could spell disaster for mankind.

programme.title: Convoy
programme.desc: Feuding with Sheriff Lyle Wallace (Ernest Borgnine), Martin Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) unites scores of his fellow-drivers via Citizen Band radio into a mile-long convoy which, powered by pent-up resentments, rolls along the Arizona highways.

programme.title: Brannigan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Chicago Police Lieutenant Jim Brannigan and Richard Attenborough co-stars as British policeman Cmdr. Swann in this action-comedy. Brannigan teams up in the U.K. with Cmdr Swann to escort a crime boss back to the U.S.

programme.title: Death Wish
programme.desc: In this explosive story of revenge and urban violence, Charles Bronson plays Paul Kersey, a bleeding-heart liberal who has a change of opinion after his wife and daughter are violently attacked by a gang of thugs in their apartment.

programme.title: Face/Off
programme.desc: As a result of a new medical technique, an agent is able to surgically take on the identical appearance of a criminal in order to take down his terrorist organization.

programme.title: The 6th Day

programme.title: Odd Man Out
programme.desc: A wounded Irish nationalist leader attempts to evade police following a failed robbery in Belfast.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Killer's Kiss
programme.desc: This dazzling film noir from Stanley Kubrick is about a struggling New York boxer (Jamie Smith), whose life is imperiled when he protects a nightclub dancer (Irene Kane) from her gangster boss.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Feast
programme.desc: Customers locked inside a bar are forced to fight monsters.

programme.title: Cabin Fever
programme.desc: A group of kids are trapped in the woods and methodically killed off by a horrifying flesh-eating virus.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: "The Ruins" follows a group of friends who become entangled in a struggle for survival after visiting a remote archaeological dig in the Mexican jungle where they discover something deadly living among the ruins.

programme.title: The Wood
programme.desc: Lots of guys have second thoughts about marriage. Three hours before his wedding, Roland is having third, fourth and fifth thoughts. Good thing he’s got buddies Slim and Mike around to help.

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
programme.desc: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.

programme.title: Attack the Block
programme.desc: ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick ass heroes.

programme.title: Preman: Silent Fury
programme.desc: After his son witnesses a brutal murder by a notorious crime boss, a deaf Indonesian gangster is thrust into the fight of his life when he takes on his dangerous former allies—including a sociopathic assassin—in order to protect his child.

programme.title: Bangkok Dog
programme.desc: Special agent Andrew Kang intercepts a drug shipment and goes undercover in Bangkok's criminal underworld. Posing as a cartel operative, he must gain the gang's trust, but as the lines blur, he risks losing himself—and his way out.

programme.title: Gladiator Underground
programme.desc: Two brothers compete in the world’s deadliest underground fighting tournament where they must decide whether to play by the rules or to cast their honor aside and team up to bring down the dark syndicate running the tournament.

programme.title: Encino Man
programme.desc: Two high school buddies dig up a frozen caveman in their backyard!

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Meet all the notorious suspects and discover all their foul play things. You'll love their dastardly doings as the bodies and the laughs pile up before your eyes. Featuring all three surprise endings!!

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly twenty years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was cancelled, the alumni cast is asked for help by an alien species in order to save the universe.

programme.title: Bewitched (2005)
programme.desc: A has-been actor tries to convince the perfect woman to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series; a woman who, unbeknownst to him, really is a witch!

programme.title: Ella Enchanted
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Anne Hathaway stars in an unforgettable, modern fairy tale in which a girl's given the gift of obedience by her Fairy Godmother. An amazing, magical adventure bursting with colorful characters, music, wit, and whimsy.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: REVOLVER is populated with Guy Ritchie's (Snatch; Lock, Stock & Two Smoking Barrels) classic breed of fast-talking, sharp-suited gangsters but with a psychological twist that your mind may not be able to handle.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Matt Damon plays Rudy Baylor, a rookie lawyer in over his head on a high-profile case. Opposing him: an army of legal sharks. On Rudy’s side: Deck Shifflet, a feisty “paralawyer” who specializes in flunking the bar exam.

programme.title: Licorice Pizza
programme.desc: Licorice Pizza' is the story of Alana Kane and Gary Valentine growing up, running around and falling in love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973. Written and Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, the film tracks the treacherous navigation of first love.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar Gilkyson (Robert Redford) lives on a Wyoming ranch with his only friend, Mitch (Morgan Freeman). Then, suddenly, the woman he blames for his son's death arrives at his door broke, desperate, and with a granddaughter he's never known.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: The Conspirator
programme.desc: From director Robert Redford comes the riveting true story behind the assassination trial of Abraham Lincoln – including the lone woman who was accused of plotting his murder.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff
programme.desc: Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend
programme.desc: An American legend comes to life in this epic Western starring Jason Patric, Robert Duvall, Gene Hackman and Wes Studi as Geronimo, giving a stunning performance as the fearless warrior who was the last Indian leader to surrender to the white man.

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic. Still, things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people in this hilarious and action-packed adventure.

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Exploring lost empires and finding priceless treasures... it's all in a day's work for Lara Croft. Though, a secret from her father's past is about to lead Lara to her greatest challenge.

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Lara Croft sets out on a quest to save Pandora's box from landing into the wrong hands. Join her as she races through furious hand-to-hand battles, blazing shoot-outs and breathtaking sky-diving escapes to try to save the ancient artifact.

programme.title: We Own the Night
programme.desc: What if your own family stood in the way of everything you worked for? Bobby Green (Joaquin Phoenix) has forsaken his name to escape his family and their tradition in law enforcement to pursue his ambitions as a Brooklyn nightclub owner. Rated R

programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: Michael Keaton and Andie MacDowell star in director Harold Ramis' brilliant comedy about a man who clones himself to save his marriage, and then almost loses his wife to himself! Keaton takes on four hilariously distinct roles.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Popeye
programme.desc: The legendary, beloved anvil-armed sailor of the seven seas comes magically to life in this delightful musical, starring Robin Williams as Popeye, who meets all challenges with the unshakable philosophy, "I yam what I yam and that's all that I yam."

programme.title: The Pope of Greenwich Village
programme.desc: Daryl Hannah, Mickey Rourke and Eric Roberts star in this funny, high-voltage story of two small-time thieves after a big score in New York's Little Italy.

programme.title: The Little Hours
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, a young servant fleeing from his master takes refuge at a convent full of emotionally unstable nuns. Introduced as a deaf mute man, he must fight to hold his cover as the nuns try to resist temptation.

programme.title: Come to Daddy
programme.desc: Elijah Wood is a man in his thirties who receives an invitation to a remote cabin for a visit with his father after a lifetime of estrangement. What he gets is much more than he ever expected!

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: Horns
programme.desc: A man wakes up after the death of his girlfriend to find he has grown horns.

programme.title: Next of Kin
programme.desc: When policeman Truman Gates' younger brother is murdered by the mob, Gates is torn between his desire to uphold the law and his lust for revenge. But Gates' older brother will not be satisfied until every member of the Chicago mob is dead.

programme.title: WarGames
programme.desc: The fate of mankind rests in the hands of a teenager (Matthew Broderick) who accidentally taps into the Defense Department's tactical computer. Dabney Coleman and Ally Sheedy co-star.

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: With brothers Mikey and Brand's house slated for demolition by greedy developers, the boys' only hope lies in finding a long-lost treasure. They uncover a treasure map and, with their friends, descend to a subterranean sea and an abandoned galleon.

programme.title: Dinner for Schmucks
programme.desc: There’s only one thing keeping aspiring executive Tim from corporate success. He must find the perfect guest to bring to his boss’s monthly dinner party, where the winner of the evening is the one who arrives with the biggest buffoon.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: Yours, Mine & Ours
programme.desc: A widowed Coast Guard Admiral and a widow handbag designer fall in love and marry, much to the dismay of her 10 and his 8 children.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Showdown at the Grand
programme.desc: A proud movie theater owner must defend his family business from corporate developers alongside a legendary action star as art imitates life in a showdown for the ages.

programme.title: Runaway Jury
programme.desc: A jury fixer plays a deadly cat-and-mouse game with a jury member and a mysterious outsider who both offer to 'deliver' the verdict to the highest bidder. Soon, lives and millions of dollars are at stake in this pulse-pounder filled with twists and turns.

programme.title: Bound
programme.desc: Caesar’s a guy who launders money for the mob. What’s the last thing that would come between a sleazy wise guy like Caesar and that money? A couple of women with brains to die for and bodies to match.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A struggling screenwriter inadvertently becomes entangled in the Los Angeles criminal underworld after his oddball friends kidnap a gangster's beloved Shih Tzu.

programme.title: Better Luck Tomorrow
programme.desc: To his classmates and teachers, high-schooler Ben Manibag appears to be the model student: a perfectionist and overachiever. But underneath this persona is a darker side. Ben and his bored high-school buddies lead double lives.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D. and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earths closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: The Phantom
programme.desc: The story begins as an expedition lands on the island of Bengalla, seeking the Skulls of Touganda. Believed to harness an energy force of power, they could spell disaster for mankind.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Brannigan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Chicago Police Lieutenant Jim Brannigan and Richard Attenborough co-stars as British policeman Cmdr. Swann in this action-comedy. Brannigan teams up in the U.K. with Cmdr Swann to escort a crime boss back to the U.S.

programme.title: Death Wish
programme.desc: In this explosive story of revenge and urban violence, Charles Bronson plays Paul Kersey, a bleeding-heart liberal who has a change of opinion after his wife and daughter are violently attacked by a gang of thugs in their apartment.

programme.title: The Parallax View
programme.desc: Warren Beatty is a news reporter who, along with seven others, witnesses the assassination of a political candidate.

programme.title: The 6th Day
programme.desc: In the very near future, cattle, fish, and even the family pet can be cloned. But cloning humans is illegal - that is, until family man Adam Gibson comes home from work one day to find a clone has replaced him. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: In the future, a division of the police department has the technology to arrest killers before they commit crimes; however, the tables turn on one of the cops working within the division.

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: Three men are disenchanted with life and try to recapture their college days.

programme.title: Eurotrip

programme.title: Here Comes the Boom
programme.desc: A biology teacher takes up fighting in mixed martial arts matches to raise money to save the school's music program.

programme.desc: With Mark and Mary's help, Jackie convinces Dan to build a chicken coop in the backyard so the family can eat organic eggs, but from a bird's-eye view, it appears that she may have ulterior motives.

programme.desc: When Becky helps Harris keep a secret from Darlene, it opens up a can of worms that causes a rift between the two sisters. Jackie supports Peter with his Nordic history project, and Dan reunites with an old friend.

programme.desc: When Dan gets injured on the job covering D.J.'s vending machine route, the choice to sue the company could lead to D.J. getting fired. Meanwhile, Jackie is appalled when Becky seeks life coaching from her nemesis.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Mientras una entidad alienígena hace estragos con la computadora de la estación, la irrefrenable Lwaxana Troi pone la mira en un romance con Odo.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Odo queda en el medio cuando una influencia alienígena enfrenta a Kira contra Sisko en una lucha fatal por el poder.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine

programme.desc: Maya ha mojado accidentalmente las alas de Beatrice. Ha perdido algo de su pólvora y ya no puede volar. Maya tiene que encontrar una solución para ayudarla, ya que la gran bola de mariposa se acerca rápidamente

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Una mosca ha robado la pelota de Ben para usarla como nido para poner sus huevos. Por desgracia, es la pelota que Ben quería mostrar en la gran reunión de escarabajos! Maya y Willy deciden ayudar a Ben a hacer una nueva pelota

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Los primos de Flip llegan al prado. Cuando están todos juntos, extrañamente cambian su color y su comportamiento. Como Flip también está cambiando, Maya se da cuenta de que podría perder a su amigo. ¡Ella hará cualquier cosa para recuperarlo!

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya y Willy han atrapado varroas, una especie de piojos de abeja. La colmena está infectada. Deciden pedir a las abejas silvestres del bosque consejos sobre cómo deshacerse de estos parásitos

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Mientras juegan, Maya y Willy rompen el caparazón de Shelby por error. Tienen que encontrar una manera de reparar la grieta antes de que se ponga peligroso para su amigo.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya quiere ayudar al Escarabajo de la señorita Rosie, una anciana que perdió su casa durante una tormenta. Ella quiere encontrar a su hermano que vive en un viejo árbol al otro lado del estanque.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: El Juez Beeswax está visitando la colmena. Es testigo de un accidente causado por Maya. Decide establecer una licencia de vuelo. Ahora las abejas tienen que permanecer en el suelo y no pueden hacer su trabajo correctamente

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya conoce a una linda peluca que es un verdadero artista y esculpe todo lo que ve. Pero su arte es malinterpretado por los otros que tienden a rechazarlo. Maya le ayudará a ser aceptado por la comunidad

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya juega con pequeñas chinches. Pronto se da cuenta de que están solas y trata de encontrar a su madre. Ella descubre que la madre está desesperada por darles de comer.

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya
programme.desc: Shelby sueña con volar. Maya y Willy quieren ayudarlo a cumplir su sueño. Pero las cosas no salen según lo planeado

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Luffy y los demás encuentran a un viejo que les cuenta en detalle la verdad sobre el robo de sombras y sobre Gecko Moria, el pirata que lidera la tripulación de Thriller Bark. Mientras tanto, Hogback descubre a Nami, Usopp y Chopper.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Tras ser derrotados por Ryuuma, Usopp, Nami y Chopper son trasladados a otro edificio en un ataúd, pero logran librarse. Al salir se encuentran en un jardín lleno de animales zombis.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Yusuke fue hospitalizado en Kanto HU después de inhalar esporas producidas por CNI26. el medico Tsubaki había declarado categóricamente que su foto no inspiraba optimismo.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Mientras lucha contra un CNI, Yusuke se da cuenta de que siente un hormigueo en el cuerpo y decide preguntarle a Sakurako si ha hecho algún progreso en la traducción de los textos.

programme.desc: Sid construye un muñeco vudú del director Wartz y jura venganza, pero cuando el Director desaparece Sid no deja de pensar que fue su culpa. / Arnold y Eugene quedan atrapados en una montaña rusa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Después de una pelea con su tío, Zuko viaja solo al Reino Tierra donde conoce a un chico y se une a él. Mientras tanto, el príncipe es perseguido por los recuerdos de su propia juventud.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang busca a Appa y Katara se esfuerza por mantenerlos a todos juntos para que puedan sobrevivir en el vasto desierto. Mientras tanto, Zuko y su tío buscan ayuda de una antigua sociedad secreta.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Con el asesino aparentemente atrapado, el equipo cree que el caso está cerrado, cuando encuentran a otra mujer muerta que coincide con el m.o. del asesino en serie. Sarah, sin saberlo, se convierte en el objetivo del verdadero asesino.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Kane y su equipo SIU corren para encontrar al distribuidor de una píldora tóxica "E" que aumenta el número de muertos en Seattle y hace que el miembro temporal de SIU, Gates, se meta en una situación de vida o muerte.

programme.title: Un amigo como tú

programme.title: Ultimo Viaje a Las Vegas

programme.title: Rugrats

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold y Helga se escapan de sus respectivas familias ya que desean pasar un día de acción de gracias normal, cosa que ninguna de las familias tiene.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold, cansado que Helga siempre se burle de él en la escuela, le pide consejo al Abuelo acerca de lo que debe hacer. / Arnold es el encargado del entretenimiento en el baile anual de la escuela y le pide a Dino Spumoni que cante en él.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Helga tiene su propio número de entretenimiento, hacer imitaciones bastante buenas de los demás. / Los chicos se quedan atrapados en la escuela cuando una tormenta inunda las calles.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: La clase del Señor Simmons hará la obra anual de la escuela, este año él eligió la obra Romeo y Julieta, y cuando Helga se entera que Arnold hará a Romeo, ella hará hasta lo imposible por quedarse con el papel de Julieta.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang y los niños llegan finalmente a Ba Sing Se a ver al rey de la tierra, sólo para descubrir que hay unas fuerzas misteriosas dentro de la ciudad que están conspirando para detenerlos.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Este episodio cuenta las diferentes aventuras que viven los personajes en Ba Sing Se. Se divide en varios cuentos: Katara y Toph, Iroh, Sokka, Aang, Zuko y Momo.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: En este episodio vamos atrás en el tiempo hasta el momento en el que Appa fue capturado. Nos enteraremos de qué pasó exactamente con él, dónde ha estado todo este tiempo y ¡dónde está ahora!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Mientras buscan a Appa, los niños se encuentran con Jet, pero no están seguros si deben confiar en él o no. Mientras tanto, Zuko también decide buscar a Appa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los chicos luchan contra Long Feng y los Dai Li para intentar demostrarle al Rey de la Tierra la gran conspiración que está teniendo lugar en su ciudad. Zuko se enferma gravemente y se enfrenta a una crisis espiritual.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Un gurú en el Templo del Aire del Este ayuda a Aang a dar el siguiente paso en su viaje hacia ser Avatar. Sokka se encuentra con su padre perdido. Azula trama un plan diabólico y Zuko y su tío abren una nueva tienda de té.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Todos comienzan una corrida contra el tiempo para detener a Azula de su siniestra conquista de Ba Sing Se. El destino de Aang pende de un hilo, al igual que el de Zuko.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Después de sufrir lesiones graves al final de la segunda temporada, Aang despierta a bordo de un barco de la Nación del Fuego. Mientras tanto, Zuko viaja de regreso a casa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Para camuflarse mejor como verdaderos ciudadanos de la Nación del Fuego, los niños roban ropas tradicionales. Aang explora una escuela de la Nación del Fuego. Zuko visita a su tío en prisión.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Cuando el grupo llega a un pueblo pescadero que se encuentra en sufirmiento, descubren que un misterioso espíritu está ayudando a los aldeanos.

programme.title: Mexico Un Plato a la Vez con Rick Bayless

programme.title: Mexico Un Plato a la Vez con Rick Bayless

programme.title: Mexico Un Plato a la Vez con Rick Bayless

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: GTA V, el juego que cambio el paradigma de diseno de Rock Star Games. Tambien, resulto siendo uno de los titulos mas exitosos para la franquicia y uno de los videojuegos mas vendidos en la historia

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Revisamos la creacion del juego independiente desarrollado por Mojang y Markus Notch Persson que definio la ultima decada. Esta es la historia detras de Minecraft.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Revisamos la historia de uno de los oficios más populares de Mario, el de conductor de autos Go Kart.

programme.title: VG Chronicles
programme.desc: En Mega Man X6-X8, X enfrenta un nuevo brote Maverick, al científico Gate y a High Max, mientras busca a Zero. Surge Axl, con habilidad de copia. La saga evoluciona gráficamente y mejora en narrativa y jugabilidad.

programme.title: VG Chronicles
programme.desc: En un mundo donde los Reploids son perseguidos, Zero despierta para unirse a la resistencia contra Neo Arcadia.

programme.title: VG Chronicles
programme.desc: La saga Castlevania comienza con Leon Belmont en el siglo XI, quien tras perder a su amada se convierte en cazador de vampiros. Su amigo Mathias se convierte en Drácula, iniciando siglos de conflicto con los Belmont.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¿Saben qué es una secuela espiritual? Lo descubriremos en éste episodio de Cybernet. También conoceremos los mejores crossovers de los videojuegos en nuestro Top 10 y recordaremos algunos de los mejores juegos basados en películas.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Abran muy bien los ojos y pongan mucha atención, ya que hoy hablaremos de los secretos y easter eggs más famosos de los videojuegos. Conoceremos algunos de los juegos cancelados que más nos han dolido.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Tenemos que admitir que no todos los videojuegos son de buena calidad, y algunos de ellos son tan malos que se han vuelto de culto. En el episodio de hoy de Cybernet recordaremos a los peores juegos de la historia.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Bienvenidos al especial de The Legend of Zelda de Cybernet. Haremos un recuento por la evolución de una de las series más famosas de la historia y en nuestro Top 10 recordaremos a los mejores jefes de la franquicia.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: El grupo va por distintos lados tras la sorpresiva aparición de Oars. Chopper se enfrenta a Hogback, Luffy va por Moria y los demás se enfrentan a Perona, quien usa sus fantasmas negativos para desmoralizarlos a todos.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Mientras los Sombrero de Paja se enfrentan con los esbirros de Moria, Oars no obedece órdenes y hace lo que quiere, causando un gran caos en Thriller Bark. ¿Podrán los Sombrero de Paja aprovechar la situación?

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Usopp sigue aprovechando su negatividad y sus mentiras para enfrentar a Perona y sus zombis. Mientras tanto, Sanji llega al rescate de Nami e inicia la pelea contra Absalom.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Sanji está furioso con Absalom, no solo por lo que le hizo a Nami, sino porque además le quitó el sueño que tenía desde niño. Por otra parte, Perona decide contraatacar en su batalla contra Usopp.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Se han dado vuelta las tornas y ahora Perona persigue a un aterrado Usopp. Muy herido y sumido en la desesperación, Usopp recurre a su héroe para que lo ayude... Sogeking.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Usopp descubre la habitación donde está el cuerpo verdadero de Perona y pasa a ganar la pelea a base de mentiras y engaños. Por su parte, Luffy sigue atacando a Moria sin conseguir lastimarlo.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Acabada la pelea entre Usopp y Perona, ahora es el turno del enfrentamiento de espadachines, Zoro con su Nitouryuu y el samurái del Reino de Waino, Ryuuma.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Es el turno de Chopper, quien quiere derrotar a Hogback para evitar que siga "reviviendo" personas. Hogback le cuenta su pasado y cómo conoció a Moria.

programme.title: One Piece - Thriller Bark Saga
programme.desc: Chopper se dispone a acabar con Hogback tras la sorpresiva reacción de Cindry, pero de repente Oars destruye todo el lugar en busca de los Sombrero de Paja.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Una serie de muertes misteriosas de estudiantes varones en la Academia Midorikawa estaba en curso.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: CNI 42 (Go Jaraji Da) sigue matando a más estudiantes varones en la Academia Midorikawa, y poco después de que una de sus víctimas rompe el ritmo de su juego al suicidarse, sale en busca de nuevas presas.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Ichijo es herido por la mujer con los tatuajes de rosas y es remitido inmediatamente a Kanto HU. Yusuke está decidido a hacer todo lo posible por Ichijo y está desconcertado por las reglas del juego creadas por CNI 43 (Go Zazaru Ba).

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: CNI 43 (Go Zazaru Ba) continúa su matanza mientras CNI 3 (Zu Goma Gu) corre rampante en Chiba. Yusuke corre hacia donde está Go Zazaru Ba y, con el apoyo de Sakurai, lo derrota.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Hay informes de que CNI 0 (N Daguva Zeba) continúa exterminando a otros CNI, y Yusuke, junto con Ichijo y los demás policías, reciben los informes realizados por la Universidad de Jonan.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga
programme.desc: Kuuga se acerca al CNI 44 (Go Jaza Gi) pero es atacado por ella, sumergido en el agua, arrojándole una lanza que le atraviesa el hombro.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Kuuga

programme.title: iCarly: Gemelas
programme.desc: Freddie trata de probar que Melanie, la hermana gemela de Sam, es en verdad Sam disfrazada. Mientras tanto, cuando Carly decide ser la tutora de Chuck, el peor enemigo de Spencer, él tratará de convencer a Carly que Chuck es diabólico.

programme.title: iCarly: Salgo con un chico malo - Parte 2
programme.desc: Cuando Carly descubre que nuevo novio colecciona pigüi babies y ella debe decidir si puede seguir una relación con alguien que es fanático de los peluches. Mientras tanto, Spencer trata de ayudar a Sam a interpretar un sueño recurrente.

programme.title: iCarly: Plagio
programme.desc: En el canal Dingo, un programa llamado Todo con Teri ha estado copiando ideas de iCarly, por eso Carly, Sam, Freddie y Spencer van al estudio Dingo.

programme.title: iCarly: Creo que se dieron un beso
programme.desc: Mientras Carly acompaña a Sam al dentista, accidentalmente Sam le confiesa a Carly que ella y Freddie se dieron un beso, Carly los increpa sobre por qué nunca le contaron.

programme.title: iCarly: A cocinar
programme.desc: Cuando Carly, Sam y Freddie derrotan a un famoso Chef de la televisión en un concurso de cocina, el Chef deja de cocinar, cancela su programa y se rehúsa a salir de su habitación. Spencer trata de hacer realidad su visión del futuro.

programme.title: iCarly: Directores
programme.desc: Cuando Carly, Sam y Freddie accidentalmente hacen que despidan al Director Franklin, La Señorita Briggs y el Señor Howard toman el control e imponen duras reglas.

programme.title: iCarly: Cita relámpago
programme.desc: Al no tener cita para el baile Sam hacen un concurso en iCarli. Pero tantos chicos se presentaron que Carly, Sam y Freddie tienen que hacer citas relámpago para conocerlos a todos. Spencer sigue una rutina muy extraña de ejercicios.

programme.title: iCarly: Creamos una estrella del pop
programme.desc: Cuando Carly, Sam y Freddie acuerdan hacer un video de música para una estrella del pop que vuelve a los escenarios, descubren que está muy fuera de estado.

programme.title: iCarly: Te salvé la vida
programme.desc: Freddy salva la vida de Carly cuando un camión estaba a punto de atropellarla. Carly se enamora de él por haberle salvado la vida y poner en riesgo la de él.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Las sospechas de L se profundizan, Light lo persuade de invitarlo a la investigación, pero en ese momento una llamada de teléfono les avisa que ¡Soichiro Yagami ha sufrido un ataque al corazón!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Como se predijo en las cintas enviadas a Sakura TV, presentadores de noticias y comentaristas que expresaron dudas sobre Kira mueren uno por uno. Siguiendo las muertes, L concluye que existe un segundo Kira.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Con un segundo Kira suelto, L le pide a Light que se una al grupo de trabajo y se haga pasar por el verdadero Kira para atrapar al imitador.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light viaja a Aoyama para descubrir la identidad de el segundo Kira antes de que L sospeche más, pero Misa Amane, la nueva Kira, usa su inusual don para encontrar a Light antes de que él la encuentre.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light y Misa muestran sus Death Notes, entonces Light le pide a Misa que use a su Shinigami Rem para que se deshaga de L, pero Misa le pide algo a cambio, ¡que se enamore de ella!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Hay evidencia que señala a Misa Amane como el segundo Kira, en un esfuerzo para salvarla, Rem obliga a Misa a renunciar como propietaria del Death Note.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Misa está en confinamiento a pesar de que sus recuerdos del Death Note han sido borrados. Cuando Light es encerrado también, los asesinatos se detienen y las sospechas hacia Light se vuelven más fuertes. De repente los asesinatos comienzan de nuevo.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Después de 50 días de reclusión, los asesinatos continúan, Misa y Light son liberados, pero L tiene un plan para garantizar que no se cometan más homicidios, por lo que el padre de Light, Soichiro, lleva a la pareja en un viaje que podría ser el último.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: A pesar de que L aún sospecha, Light y Misa (sus recuerdos de haber sido Kira han sido borrados) regresan al cuartel donde Light se da cuenta de una extraña conección entre los recientes asesinatos de Kira y el Grupo Yotsuba.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: El Asalto

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
